description: Resource Management sequence — the meta layer of the curriculum: how software is made well. Algorithmic complexity, data locality/caching, real-time vs offline, version control, testing/debugging, hardware.

big_o_complexity.name: Algorithmic Complexity (Big O)
big_o_complexity.description: The complexity race — one bar per Big-O class (O(1) to O(2^n)) growing as the input size n sweeps up. At small n they stand level; at large n the quadratic and exponential peg the ceiling and flash OFF CHART. Scale made visible.

parameters.n_max: Largest input size the sweep reaches (default 24)
parameters.sweep_seconds: Seconds for n to sweep 1 -> n_max (default 8)
parameters.freeze_n: If > 0, hold at this n (for stills) instead of animating

data_locality_caching.name: Data Locality & Caching
data_locality_caching.description: The memory hierarchy ladder — registers, L1/L2/L3, RAM, disk stacked with log-latency gaps. A probe climbs to fetch: fast (HIT) when data is near, ruinously slow (MISS) when far. Where a thing IS costs more than what it is.

parameters.cycle_seconds: Seconds for the probe to cycle levels
parameters.freeze_level: -1 animate; >=0 park the probe at a level for stills

realtime_vs_offline.name: Real-time vs Offline Processing
realtime_vs_offline.description: Twin pipelines — a real-time lane with a frame deadline (finish or drop, red) and an offline lane with no deadline (all complete, full quality). The clock changes the algorithm.

version_control_tree.name: Version Control
version_control_tree.description: A commit tree — a main branch and a feature branch that peels off and merges back, with HEAD advancing commit by commit. History as a navigable branching shape, not a line.

parameters.freeze_head: -1 animate; >=0 park HEAD at a commit for stills

test_harness.name: Testing & Debugging
test_harness.description: A test board — a grid of cases that pass green or fail red. Inject a bug and a band flips red; fix it and they heal left to right. A test is a claim about the future.

parameters.freeze_phase: -1 animate; 0 green / 1 bug / 2 fixing for stills

hardware_cross_section.name: Hardware Considerations
hardware_cross_section.description: A machine cutaway — CPU, GPU, RAM, cache, disk strung on a bus, with data tokens flowing at component-specific throughput (cache fast, disk slow). The algorithm runs on a place, not in the abstract.
